intro: Excella elevates your productivity. A modern, touch-and-memory adjustable desk with built-in drawer, charging port, and stable support in a compact, stylish footprint.

features.title: Smart height memory
features.text: Adjust your desk height with a touch or store up to four presets for quick transitions—ideal for alternating between tasks without resetting every time.

features.title: Sleek and strong design
features.text: Maple-finished top with a sturdy white metal frame blends into any room decor while providing long-lasting durability and style.

features.title: Hidden storage drawer
features.text: A seamlessly built-in drawer offers discreet storage for supplies, letting you stay organized without taking up desktop space.

features.title: Stay charged, stay focused
features.text: Integrated USB-C port keeps your devices powered without extra wires or reaching under the desk—perfect for modern work needs.

features.title: Reliable 50 kg load
features.text: Designed to hold up to 50 kg, the surface is ideal for laptops, books, or project setups—supportive without compromising style.

features.title: Balanced anywhere
features.text: Bush-adjustable feet keep your workspace even and stable, adapting to any floor for a wobble-free experience.

name: Excella2 Particle Board Height Adjustable Touch Study Table
